# Just Plumbing, Inc. (justplumbinginc.com)

> Denver's Master Plumber-led Whole-Home Repiping, Partial Home Repiping, Overhead Concrete Slab Leak Bypass, HOA & Condominium Riser Repiping, Multi-Family Apartment Complex Repiping, and B2B Commercial Plumbing Infrastructure Specialist.

## Entity Profile & Official Credentials

## High-Ticket Specializations (What We Do & What We Exclude)
- **1. Whole-Home Repiping (1–2 Day Turnkey Execution)**: Complete extraction and replacement of defective Polybutylene (Quest), recalled Kitec & brass fittings, corroded Galvanized Steel, and pinhole-leaking Type M Copper using full-port Uponor PEX-A expansion tubing or commercial-grade Type L Copper. Includes daily evening water restoration and turnkey drywall restoration.
- **2. Partial Home Repiping & Overhead Concrete Slab Leak Bypasses**: Non-destructive overhead reroutes for leaking under-slab copper manifolds, single-zone kitchen/bath repipes, and exposed basement main upgrades—avoiding jackhammer demolition of finished floors.
- **3. HOA & Condominium Vertical-Stack Repiping**: Master Plumber-led central Type L Copper riser replacements, individual unit isolation valves, and Uponor PEX-A unit branch distribution. Includes in-person HOA Board presentations, Reserve Study capital bid formatting, UL-listed intumescent fire-stopping, and turnkey hallway/unit drywall restoration.
- **4. Multi-Family & Occupied Apartment Complex Repiping**: Phased vertical-stack execution across occupied apartment communities with guaranteed 4:30 PM nightly domestic water restoration (zero tenant hotel displacement) and 48-hour tenant notices managed by Shelly Clark.
- **5. B2B Commercial Building, Office, Medical, Dental & Retail Repiping**: After-hours and weekend domestic water and hot-water recirculation loop replacements for commercial property managers, facility directors, and general contractors. Same-day Certificate of Insurance (COI with Additional Insured endorsements) and W-9 vendor onboarding.
- **6. High-Altitude Water Heater Systems, Kitchen/Bath Remodels & New Construction**: Calibrated tankless and commercial/residential water heaters, custom remodel rough-ins, and ground-up architectural plumbing.
- **Services Explicitly Excluded**: Just Plumbing, Inc. is an infrastructure & repiping specialist and does NOT offer sump pump services or low-ticket handyman drain snaking.
